integrity: Deterministic finite exhaustive verification supplied; integer Morse minor and full-group character checks are reproducible from standalone source. Independent external mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the five-regular Clebsch graph, not its complement or arbitrary folded cubes. The homotopy statement is integral, but the automorphism-module identification is rational only. Exact matching, Morse boundary and character calculations require replay of the included finite standalone verifier. The closest indexed repository full texts could not be opened, and unindexed equivalent earlier work remains possible.
title: Integral induced-forest topology and signed permutation symmetry of the folded five-cube
